changes.title: New Mexico woman's bodycam confession about hiding newborn baby in hospital garbage tossed by state court
changes.summary: The New Mexico Supreme Court ruled that the body camera footage of a woman confessing to hiding her newborn baby in a hospital trash can in an attempt to conceal her pregnancy cannot be used by prosecutors in her murder case because of doctor-patient confidentiality. changes.summary: Senator Susan Collins, who supports abortion rights, endorsed Brett Kavanaugh’s nomination for the Supreme Court. It has emerged as a major issue in her campaign for re-election.

changes.title: Trump’s Global Tariffs: What’s the Latest on the Trade War

changes.title: Trump imposes double-digit tariffs on dozens of countries as stopgap 10% levies expire Friday
changes.summary: President Donald Trump is going ahead with new double-digit tariffs on dozens of U.S. trading partners just as the clock runs out Friday on stopgap levies he imposed after a stinging defeat at the Supreme Court.
